units.displayText: On the Outer Ring of the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText: The Entropy has completely taken over this sector. None of the buildings here retain any semblance of their original appearances.

units.rawText: Not just that, after infected agents die, they become new Entropics, who continue to spread the catastrophe.

units.rawText: Quit... quit it already! Just thinking about how these things worked their way into my neural cloud scares the crap out of me!
units.displayText: Quit... quit it already! Just thinking about how these things worked their way into my neural cloud scares the crap out of me!

spans.text: Quit... quit it already! Just thinking about how these things worked their way into my neural cloud scares the crap out of me!

units.rawText: They won't just invade your neural cloud, they'll also trap you in your Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: They won't just invade your neural cloud, they'll also trap you in your Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: They won't just invade your neural cloud, they'll also trap you in your Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: If nobody wakes you up from there in time, your neural cloud will be steadily consumed, dominated, and in the end you will become one of them.
units.displayText: If nobody wakes you up from there in time, your neural cloud will be steadily consumed, dominated, and in the end you will become one of them.

spans.text: If nobody wakes you up from there in time, your neural cloud will be steadily consumed, dominated, and in the end you will become one of them.

units.rawText: ...And then you can kill me as a matter of course, right?
units.displayText: ...And then you can kill me as a matter of course, right?

spans.text: ...And then you can kill me as a matter of course, right?

units.rawText: I heard the Prof say you just killed one of your own people.

units.rawText: That was something I had to do.

units.rawText: If the day comes when I ever get infected, I will gladly accept the release Lord Eosphorus grants me.

units.rawText: Tsk...
units.displayText: Tsk...

Let Wisdom explain.

units.rawText: Wisdom, I remember you said something about the clues pointing toward the Sector Administrator.
units.displayText: Wisdom, I remember you said something about the clues pointing toward the Sector Administrator.

units.rawText: Ah, that's right!
units.displayText: Ah, that's right!

spans.text: Ah, that's right!

units.rawText: There seems to be a strange shift in Wisdom's attitude when she's talking to me...
units.displayText: There seems to be a strange shift in Wisdom's attitude when she's talking to me...

spans.text: There seems to be a strange shift in Wisdom's attitude when she's talking to me...

units.rawText: According to my combat analysis, we encounter 35% more resistance when we move toward the Admin Center.
units.displayText: According to my combat analysis, we encounter 35% more resistance when we move toward the Admin Center.

spans.text: According to my combat analysis, we encounter 35% more resistance when we move toward the Admin Center.

units.rawText: That's why I have reason to believe these Entropics are protecting something.
units.displayText: That's why I have reason to believe these Entropics are protecting something.

spans.text: That's why I have reason to believe these Entropics are protecting something.

units.rawText: Although the Entropics are everywhere, we encounter more resistance when we move in a specific direction.
units.displayText: Although the Entropics are everywhere, we encounter more resistance when we move in a specific direction.

spans.text: Although the Entropics are everywhere, we encounter more resistance when we move in a specific direction.

units.rawText: In fact, Entropics from the other directions will converge on our location to provide support.
units.displayText: In fact, Entropics from the other directions will converge on our location to provide support.

spans.text: In fact, Entropics from the other directions will converge on our location to provide support.

units.rawText: After the previous battle, I've got a rough idea of where their defenses are heaviest.

spans.text: After the previous battle, I've got a rough idea of where their defenses are heaviest.

units.rawText: Oh, I've come to the same conclusion.
units.displayText: Oh, I've come to the same conclusion.

spans.text: Oh, I've come to the same conclusion.

units.rawText: I presume you're talking about the direction of the Admin Center.
units.displayText: I presume you're talking about the direction of the Admin Center.

spans.text: I presume you're talking about the direction of the Admin Center.

units.rawText: You mean someone is still leading these Entropics? But all our previous analyses show that their movements are chaotic and erratic...
units.displayText: You mean someone is still leading these Entropics? But all our previous analyses show that their movements are chaotic and erratic...

spans.text: You mean someone is still leading these Entropics? But all our previous analyses show that their movements are chaotic and erratic...

units.rawText: Well, that's just a theory for now.
units.displayText: Well, that's just a theory for now.

spans.text: Well, that's just a theory for now.

units.rawText: It's hard enough dealing with these monsters as individuals! If they've got organization and leadership...!
units.displayText: It's hard enough dealing with these monsters as individuals! If they've got organization and leadership...!

spans.text: It's hard enough dealing with these monsters as individuals! If they've got organization and leadership...!

units.rawText: In any case, we'll know the answer once we reach the Admin Center.
units.displayText: In any case, we'll know the answer once we reach the Admin Center.

spans.text: In any case, we'll know the answer once we reach the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Understood. I'll be counting on you to pull up a map, Antonina.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll be counting on you to pull up a map, Antonina.

units.rawText: Um... I hate to say this, but I might not be able to find a map doc right away...
units.displayText: Um... I hate to say this, but I might not be able to find a map doc right away...

spans.text: Um... I hate to say this, but I might not be able to find a map doc right away...

units.rawText: We Sanctifiers all have maps of the publicly-accessible routes in a sector. All you need to do is follow us.

units.rawText: Really? That's a great help!
units.displayText: Really? That's a great help!

spans.text: Really? That's a great help!

units.rawText: We'll be counting on you to lead the way then, Wisdom.
units.displayText: We'll be counting on you to lead the way then, Wisdom.

units.rawText: Humph, piece of cake.

units.rawText: Looks like the Sanctifiers truly mean to cooperate.

spans.text: Practically none of the Lessers have died... I hate to admit this, but I truly haven't fought such a successful battle against the Entropics before.

units.rawText: You guys are... really good, especially the Professor's leadership...
units.displayText: You guys are... really good, especially the Professor's leadership...

spans.text: You guys are... really good, especially the Professor's leadership...

units.rawText: Do the Sanctifiers usually take a lot of casualties?
units.displayText: Do the Sanctifiers usually take a lot of casualties?

spans.text: Do the Sanctifiers usually take a lot of casualties?

units.rawText: Yeah... It's not uncommon to lose all our Lessers against Entropic incursions of this scale.

spans.text: Yeah... It's not uncommon to lose all our Lessers against Entropic incursions of this scale.

units.rawText: No, perhaps we might only be able to make this happen with the personal direction of our wise and mighty Lord Eosphorus.
